class.name: OcgGpAx2
class.brief_description: Describes a right-handed coordinate system in 3D space. A coordinate system is defined by: - its origin (also referred to as its "Location point"), and - three orthogonal unit vectors, termed respectively the "X Direction", the "Y Direction" and the "Direction" (also referred to as the "main Direction"). The "Direction" of the coordinate system is called its "main Direction" because whenever this unit vector is modified, the "X Direction" and the "Y Direction" are recomputed. However, when we modify either the "X Direction" or the "Y Direction", "Direction" is not modified. The "main Direction" is also the "Z Direction". Since an Ax2 coordinate system is right-handed, its "main Direction" is always equal to the cross product of its "X Direction" and "Y Direction". (To define a left-handed coordinate system, use gp_Ax3.) A coordinate system is used: - to describe geometric entities, in particular to position them. The local coordinate system of a geometric entity serves the same purpose as the STEP function "axis placement two axes", or - to define geometric transformations. Note: we refer to the "X Axis", "Y Axis" and "Z Axis", respectively, as to axes having: - the origin of the coordinate system as their origin, and - the unit vectors "X Direction", "Y Direction" and "main Direction", respectively, as their unit vectors. The "Z Axis" is also the "main Axis".

method.name: default
method.description: Creates an object corresponding to the reference coordinate system (OXYZ).

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates - a coordinate system with an origin P, where V gives the "main Direction" (here, "X Direction" and "Y Direction" are defined automatically).

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates an axis placement with an origin P such that: - N is the Direction, and - the "X Direction" is normal to N, in the plane defined by the vectors (N, Vx): "X Direction" = (N ^ Vx) ^ N, Exception: raises ConstructionError if N and Vx are parallel (same or opposite orientation).

method.name: SetAxis
method.description: Assigns the origin and "main Direction" of the axis A1 to this coordinate system, then recomputes its "X Direction" and "Y Direction". Note: The new "X Direction" is computed as follows: new "X Direction" = V1 ^(previous "X Direction" ^ V) where V is the "Direction" of A1. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if A1 is parallel to the "X Direction" of this coordinate system.

method.name: SetDirection
method.description: Changes the "main Direction" of this coordinate system, then recomputes its "X Direction" and "Y Direction". Note: the new "X Direction" is computed as follows: new "X Direction" = V ^ (previous "X Direction" ^ V) Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if V is parallel to the "X Direction" of this coordinate system.

method.name: SetLocation
method.description: Changes the "Location" point (origin) of <me>.

method.name: SetXDirection
method.description: Changes the "Xdirection" of <me>. The main direction "Direction" is not modified, the "Ydirection" is modified. If <Vx> is not normal to the main direction then <XDirection> is computed as follows XDirection = Direction ^ (Vx ^ Direction). Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if Vx or Vy is parallel to the "main Direction" of this coordinate system.

method.name: SetYDirection
method.description: Changes the "Ydirection" of <me>. The main direction is not modified but the "Xdirection" is changed. If <Vy> is not normal to the main direction then "YDirection" is computed as follows YDirection = Direction ^ (<Vy> ^ Direction). Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if Vx or Vy is parallel to the "main Direction" of this coordinate system.

method.name: Angle
method.description: Computes the angular value, in radians, between the main direction of <me> and the main direction of <theOther>. Returns the angle between 0 and PI in radians.

method.name: Axis
method.description: Returns the main axis of <me>. It is the "Location" point and the main "Direction".

method.name: Direction
method.description: Returns the main direction of <me>.

method.name: Location
method.description: Returns the "Location" point (origin) of <me>.

method.name: XDirection
method.description: Returns the "XDirection" of <me>.

method.name: YDirection
method.description: Returns the "YDirection" of <me>.

method.name: IsCoplanar_2
method.description: Returns True if . the distance between <me> and the "Location" point of A1 is lower of equal to LinearTolerance and . the main direction of <me> and the direction of A1 are normal. Note: the tolerance criterion for angular equality is given by AngularTolerance.

method.name: Mirror_1
method.description: Performs a symmetrical transformation of this coordinate system with respect to: - the point P, and assigns the result to this coordinate system. Warning This transformation is always performed on the origin. In case of a reflection with respect to a point: - the main direction of the coordinate system is not changed, and - the "X Direction" and the "Y Direction" are simply reversed In case of a reflection with respect to an axis or a plane: - the transformation is applied to the "X Direction" and the "Y Direction", then - the "main Direction" is recomputed as the cross product "X Direction" ^ "Y Direction". This maintains the right-handed property of the coordinate system.

method.name: Mirrored_1
method.description: Performs a symmetrical transformation of this coordinate system with respect to: - the point P, and creates a new one. Warning This transformation is always performed on the origin. In case of a reflection with respect to a point: - the main direction of the coordinate system is not changed, and - the "X Direction" and the "Y Direction" are simply reversed In case of a reflection with respect to an axis or a plane: - the transformation is applied to the "X Direction" and the "Y Direction", then - the "main Direction" is recomputed as the cross product "X Direction" ^ "Y Direction". This maintains the right-handed property of the coordinate system.

method.name: Mirror_2
method.description: Performs a symmetrical transformation of this coordinate system with respect to: - the axis A1, and assigns the result to this coordinate systeme. Warning This transformation is always performed on the origin. In case of a reflection with respect to a point: - the main direction of the coordinate system is not changed, and - the "X Direction" and the "Y Direction" are simply reversed In case of a reflection with respect to an axis or a plane: - the transformation is applied to the "X Direction" and the "Y Direction", then - the "main Direction" is recomputed as the cross product "X Direction" ^ "Y Direction". This maintains the right-handed property of the coordinate system.

method.name: Mirrored_2
method.description: Performs a symmetrical transformation of this coordinate system with respect to: - the axis A1, and creates a new one. Warning This transformation is always performed on the origin. In case of a reflection with respect to a point: - the main direction of the coordinate system is not changed, and - the "X Direction" and the "Y Direction" are simply reversed In case of a reflection with respect to an axis or a plane: - the transformation is applied to the "X Direction" and the "Y Direction", then - the "main Direction" is recomputed as the cross product "X Direction" ^ "Y Direction". This maintains the right-handed property of the coordinate system.

method.name: Mirror_3
method.description: Performs a symmetrical transformation of this coordinate system with respect to: - the plane defined by the origin, "X Direction" and "Y Direction" of coordinate system A2 and assigns the result to this coordinate systeme. Warning This transformation is always performed on the origin. In case of a reflection with respect to a point: - the main direction of the coordinate system is not changed, and - the "X Direction" and the "Y Direction" are simply reversed In case of a reflection with respect to an axis or a plane: - the transformation is applied to the "X Direction" and the "Y Direction", then - the "main Direction" is recomputed as the cross product "X Direction" ^ "Y Direction". This maintains the right-handed property of the coordinate system.

method.name: Mirrored_3
method.description: Performs a symmetrical transformation of this coordinate system with respect to: - the plane defined by the origin, "X Direction" and "Y Direction" of coordinate system A2 and creates a new one. Warning This transformation is always performed on the origin. In case of a reflection with respect to a point: - the main direction of the coordinate system is not changed, and - the "X Direction" and the "Y Direction" are simply reversed In case of a reflection with respect to an axis or a plane: - the transformation is applied to the "X Direction" and the "Y Direction", then - the "main Direction" is recomputed as the cross product "X Direction" ^ "Y Direction". This maintains the right-handed property of the coordinate system.

method.name: Rotated
method.description: Rotates an axis placement. <theA1> is the axis of the rotation. theAng is the angular value of the rotation in radians.

method.name: Scaled
method.description: Applies a scaling transformation on the axis placement. The "Location" point of the axisplacement is modified. Warnings : If the scale <S> is negative : . the main direction of the axis placement is not changed. . The "XDirection" and the "YDirection" are reversed. So the axis placement stay right handed.

method.name: Transformed
method.description: Transforms an axis placement with a Trsf. The "Location" point, the "XDirection" and the "YDirection" are transformed with theT. The resulting main "Direction" of <me> is the cross product between the "XDirection" and the "YDirection" after transformation.

method.name: Translated_1
method.description: Translates an axis plaxement in the direction of the vector <theV>. The magnitude of the translation is the vector's magnitude.

method.name: Translated_2
method.description: Translates an axis placement from the point <theP1> to the point <theP2>.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
